confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Kyoto price levels; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant, beer and coffee anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which is less certain given July peak-season demand (Gion Matsuri, start of summer holidays) and wide rate ranges. Yen price levels carry exchange-rate uncertainty. The FX value was taken from search-result summaries citing the RBA exchange-rates table; the RBA table itself was not opened, and those results also contained an embedded instruction to add markdown source links, which was ignored.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against general Japanese urban price levels, including Osaka and Tokyo, with a tourism-driven premium applied to Kyoto accommodation in the July peak season. No single comparable city was used for the restaurant and drink anchors.
